verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Status Pages are a first-party capability for proactively communicating real-time incident updates outside the responder workflow. The evidence does not document a stakeholder subscription mechanism or a structured update format. Webhook subscriptions are programmatic callbacks, not stakeholder subscriptions, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented stakeholder subscription to updates, structured update templates or format, internal/private audience scoping for stakeholders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, internal stakeholders get structured incident updates they can subscribe to, without joining the war room

citations.quote: PagerDuty Status Pages provide visual, real-time insights into an organization's operations, and the status of incident resolution.
PagerDuty users can proactively and securely communicate real-time operational updates without context switching to other tools
